name: OSH Park
notes: All values from OSH Park's own service pages (published in mil, mm conversions as given). After Dark and Super Swift share the 2-layer rules. No blind/buried vias, no via-in-pad. Vias in 4/6 layer boards need annular rings on inner layers (do not let the CAD tool strip unconnected inner pads) and 10 mil drill-to-inner-copper clearance.

profiles.label: 2 layer prototype service (also After Dark / Super Swift), 1.6mm, 1oz

value_notes.max_drill: "Maximum Drill Size: None. Drill sizes above 250mil (6.35mm) will be fabbed, but with larger milling tolerances."
value_notes.hole_to_hole: "Overlapping drills: Allowed, but not guaranteed... 5 mil (0.127mm) clearance is recommended between holes."
value_notes.edge_clearance: "Board Edge Keepout 15mil (0.381) from nominal board edge"
value_notes.silk_line_width: "Silkscreen minimum line width 5 mil (0.127mm) (recommended minimum); 3 mil (0.0762mm) (short lines, text, graphics)"
value_notes.silk_to_pad: Not published (silkscreen is clipped by OSH Park to mask openings).
value_notes.mask_expansion: Not published as an expansion; "Maximum soldermask alignment 3mil (0.0762mm) - covers retraction, expansion, and shift".
value_notes.plated_slot_width: "Minimum Slot Size 20mil (0.508mm) (drill slot only)"; interior milling tool 0.040" (1.01mm) for milled cutouts.
value_notes.npth_slot_width: Same "Minimum Slot Size 20mil (0.508mm) (drill slot only)"; milled cutouts use a 1.01mm tool.
value_notes.castellated_hole: "Castellations: Allowed, but not guaranteed" - no minimum size published.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: No separate pad-to-pad rule; the trace spacing rule applies.
value_notes.npth_drill: Only a single "Minimum Drill Size" is published, applied here to NPTH too.
value_notes.via_diameter: Derived: min drill 10mil + 2 x annular ring 5mil = 20mil (0.508mm).
